jump_sheet.height_basis: One shared equivalent erect height, approximately 400 source pixels; recover pose visible height is 387 with flexed knees. Never scale each pose by its own bbox.

calibration.coordinate_system: absolute source pixels, x right, y down, bbox max exclusive
calibration.order: row major, 4 poses on first row then 4 on second; explicit bboxes override assumed grid
calibration.root_contract: Grounded stages 0/5/6/7 use a support-line proxy. Airborne stages 1/2/3/4 use the local virtual standing-foot proxy estimated by extending the legs under the pelvis. Crop/export aligns that proxy to anchor, removing source-layout vertical offsets. height_px is then applied once by preview playback.
calibration.height_contract: height_px values [0,8,50,80,50,0,0,0] are independent OUTPUT pixels for a demonstration only. Do not additionally apply source root_y/row differences or align each frame by the lowest foot.
calibration.foot_contract: foot is one actual visible lower boot-sole point for overlay review; it is not the root estimator for airborne poses.
calibration.timing_contract: Full 38-tick demonstration [6,3,6,5,6,2,5,5]. This is not a fixed runtime jump duration. Phase clips reuse existing source IDs; no new poses are claimed. Runtime phase transitions must follow physics.
calibration.alpha_observation: Source is real RGBA (alpha 0..255), but faint nonzero-alpha speckles reach image and crop edges. All 8 substantial connected components appear when alpha>24. allow_edge_alpha accepts existing faint edge remnants for this draft; it does not mean cleaned final alpha. Source is unchanged.
calibration.bbox_contract: Every bbox includes complete visible actor, sword and scabbard with padding around the substantial alpha component. No source pixel processing was performed.
visual_limitations: Push-off stage 1 retains a bent supporting leg, so a distinct straight-leg extension is missing.
Sword orientation varies little; near hand carries the blade while the off hand stays forward through most airborne stages.
Prepare and compression silhouettes resemble battle crouches; compression touches the left hand toward the floor.
Recovery retains a wide bent-knee combat stance, so a neutral standing transition is still missing.
Manual roots are approximate (+/-10 source pixels) and require playback review; no final approval is claimed.
calibration.verification: Viewed original source and measured 8 substantial alpha components; JSON and bounds checked. No export files or previews generated in this task.
